body.statement: If \(n\ge d^3\), then \(c_\epsilon d/n\le R_{n,d,\epsilon}\le C_\epsilon d/n\) on the full class \(\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}\).
body.justification: This matching regime is the first solved portion of the frontier and a mandatory calibration point for any sparse reconstruction.
body.gap: Paired-binomial law recovery fixes entity weights and trials, while categorical ATE theory targets a scalar; neither yields the \(d/n\) observational law frontier.
body.consumer: Analysts with many observations per categorical profile obtain an exact order for full-distribution recovery.
